name: Two founders
description: Two founders with long bios in a narrow panel.

data.heading: Founded by two friends
data.subheading: We started this company after one too many bad experiences with the alternatives.

members.name: Aisha Khan
members.bio: Spent a decade in product at high-growth startups before starting the company in 2019. She still answers customer emails on Fridays.

members.name: Marco Rossi
members.bio: Built payment systems for banks across three continents. He believes software should be boring in production and delightful in use.
